channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Amid questions over Japan’s cybersecurity, just how safe is the My Number system?
item.description: With over 80% of the population using My Number, concerns have emerged over the country's all-in-one card and the personal information stored in it.

item.title: Ruling bloc kicks off first working-level talks on Japan security strategy overhaul
item.description: Revising a longtime ban on bringing nuclear weapons into the country and acquiring nuclear-powered submarines are seen as key points of contention.

item.title: BOJ summary suggests good chance of December interest rate hike
item.description: The Bank of Japan's brief record of the latest policy meeting indicated many board members see a near-term interest rate hike as necessary.

item.title: Top yen forecaster predicts ¥147 per dollar as rate gap narrows
item.description: The call puts him at the bullish end of a deeply divided market.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
